remarks: Offered for rent this second-floor apartment is ideal for seeking a tenant looking for a quiet living environment. This apartment is attached to the owner's main residence and situated on a quiet street just moments from downtown New Canaan and Metro-North. The apartment has a spacious bedroom with double sized closets and a full bathroom with shower and additional storage. A washer and dryer are conveniently located within the apartment. The main area includes an eat in kitchen and living room with gas fireplace. The apartment has great natural light, hardwood floors throughout, is fully furnished and outfitted with all the kitchen necessities. The heating and cooling system has its own thermostat. Utilities included, except gas heat. On premises parking for one vehicle with garbage/recycling disposal included.
